FINDING_2_TWO_GRAPHS_AT_THE_SAME_DISPATC.why_this_is_the_headline: S031 §4 makes DISPATCHES_PER_ACCEPTED_TOKEN the hard metric and sets a ladder 964 -> <750 -> <500 -> <300 -> <200. This is a direct test of whether that number predicts cost.
FINDING_2_TWO_GRAPHS_AT_THE_SAME_DISPATC.not_merely_equal_per_token: the raw totals are byte-identical at BOTH probe lengths, 9072 and 12096

and_a_second_demonstration_in_the_other_.reading: 64 FEWER dispatches bought nothing measurable, so the metric fails in both directions: equal counts can differ and unequal counts can match

FINDING_2_TWO_GRAPHS_AT_THE_SAME_DISPATC.PREDICTION_WRITTEN_BEFORE_THE_RUN: 2.8-3.8%, derived from this session's own per-lever marginals with NO unaccounted remainder (64x16.89 + 64x3.92 + 48x3.11 + 32x3.11 us against A's 208x3.11)
FINDING_2_TWO_GRAPHS_AT_THE_SAME_DISPATC.outcome: CONFIRMED at 3.749%, the top edge of the band. The DEVICE_RESIDENT receipt diagnosed five consecutive misses-high as predicting from a decomposition with a 19% remainder; predicting from one with none is the fix, and this is the first prediction in this pipeline to land inside its band.

FINDING_3_A_DISPATCH_IS_NOT_A_UNIT_OF_CO.the_control_is_what_makes_the_outlier_re: three levers agree at 2.64-2.91 us/dispatch on the GPU and one is 17.35 -- 6.6x -- and the flanking measurement is the OTHER HALF OF THE SAME FLAG, measured in the same block with the same instrument on the same machine. gate_up=pair and the swiglu step are both FUSE_MLP; one is 17.35 and one is 2.86.
FINDING_3_A_DISPATCH_IS_NOT_A_UNIT_OF_CO.so_2_7_us_is_a_real_dispatch_cost_and_th: 1.1106 ms saved minus 64 x 2.75 us of dispatch = 0.935 ms, so 84% of the pair win is NOT dispatch elimination

it_is_not_the_host.reading: the pair step moved host by +0.017 ms while wall moved 1.094 ms. The entire win is GPU execution, which independently confirms S031's ~1.1% host figure from a different measurement.

and_it_is_not_DRAM_BANDWIDTH_and_that_is.what_the_pair_kernel_eliminates: gate and up are separate matvecs each streaming the full input row per output row; fused, affine_q2_unpack8_dual_g64 reads gpacked and upacked at the SAME byte offset against ONE loaded input slice
and_it_is_not_DRAM_BANDWIDTH_and_that_is.conclusion: a 34.8x overshoot of this machine's own measured DRAM bandwidth (MACHINE_GENOME.json, 589.73 GB/s median, 1.89% IQR) means those loads were NOT coming from DRAM. The win is cache/register traffic and load-issue slots, not bytes off the bus.

the_byte_lever_measured_in_the_same_bloc.what_the_swiglu_step_eliminates: gk_swiglu_f32 writes and re-reads 17408 f32 per layer
the_byte_lever_measured_in_the_same_bloc.reading: S031 §2 orders ELIMINATE BYTES above ELIMINATE DISPATCHES. At the magnitudes actually available on this body at decode that ordering is INVERTED: removing 8.91 MB of genuine DRAM traffic bought 15 us while removing the 64 dispatches that carried it bought 183 us. This is a statement about these magnitudes on this body, not a general reversal of the principle.

FINDING_5_A_CORRECTION_TO_MY_OWN_CEILING.what_TOKEN_GRAPH_REDUCTION_TIMED_did: derived 3.42 us per removed dispatch from ONE lever set and extrapolated a ~37 TPS ceiling for deleting every dispatch, and derived that the <200 rung reaches 36.2 raw / 25.2 accepted
FINDING_5_A_CORRECTION_TO_MY_OWN_CEILING.why_the_method_is_void: 3.42 was a FAMILY AVERAGE over levers that happen to be cheap. The constant varies 6.6x by lever, so no single us/dispatch figure can be multiplied by a dispatch count.
FINDING_5_A_CORRECTION_TO_MY_OWN_CEILING.what_survives: the ~2.7 us figure is now MEASURED UNIFORM across three independent levers with one named exception, which is better evidence than the original had. Deleting the dispatch overhead of all 628 remaining ~ 628 x 2.75 us = 1.73 ms, giving 25.86 ms/token = 38.7 raw TPS.
FINDING_5_A_CORRECTION_TO_MY_OWN_CEILING.and_the_arithmetic_accident_that_nearly_: the corrected ceiling (38.7) is close to the original (37), so the number would have looked fine while the reasoning behind it was wrong. The ladder in S031 §4 was already at its practical end and the finding is not that the ceiling moved but that the LEVER IS NOT DISPATCH COUNT -- the pair lever shows a non-dispatch axis worth 14.6 us per fused pair, which is where the remaining headroom on this body lives.

A_SILENT_ZERO_BRANCH_NAMED_NOT_FIXED.what: the accumulation is guarded by `row < rows && (cols % 64u) == 0u`. If cols is not a multiple of 64 the loop never runs, acc_g and acc_u stay 0, and the kernel WRITES silu(0)*0 = 0 for every row -- a full zero activation with no error and no fallback.
A_SILENT_ZERO_BRANCH_NAMED_NOT_FIXED.reachable_here: NO. hidden_size 5120 and intermediate_size 17408 are both multiples of 64 on this body, so the branch never fires and no measurement here is affected.
A_SILENT_ZERO_BRANCH_NAMED_NOT_FIXED.why_it_is_recorded: a shape that silently produces zeros is the class this program keeps finding, and the guard is one artifact away from firing. Not fixed because changing a production shader's guard direction needs its own evidence and its own control.
A_SILENT_ZERO_BRANCH_NAMED_NOT_FIXED.also_a_naming_hazard: the UNFUSED MLP kernel is named qwen_affine_q2_group32_matvec_geo_tpr64_tg128 and branches on a RUNTIME group_size, taking the g64 path on this artifact. MIX_REPORT.json says so in its own words -- kernel_family 'affine2_group32_matvec (group_size bind 32 or 64)'. The atlas histogram names a kernel FAMILY, not the codec that executed, and a reader taking group32 literally would conclude the fused g64 kernel was reading the wrong scales.

claim_boundary: ONE artifact, ONE prompt (11 tokens), ONE generation length (64 new, EOS at 49), ONE machine, INSTANCE. The 3.75% at equal dispatch count is measured at this length and this shape and nothing here says it holds at 1024 tokens.
3 admitted sweeps per arm. The result is admitted by COMPLETE SEPARATION of clusters whose spreads are 0.12-0.37% -- far inside the 10% gate -- and not by a 200-rep count.

CAPABILITY IS NOT YET IN THIS RECEIPT. The 628-dispatch graph has NOT been through the 43-case suite at the time of writing, so the §18 floor is NOT cleared for it and no accepted-TPS figure is claimed. A dispatch reduction that is not capability-preserving is not a win.

The 34.8x DRAM overshoot RULES OUT a bandwidth explanation for the pair lever; it does NOT establish which of load-issue, cache traffic or register pressure is the mechanism. The experiment that would settle it -- a kernel that fuses the dispatch while still loading the input twice -- does not exist and was not built.

GPU time is per-COMMAND-BUFFER (GPUEndTime-GPUStartTime), so every per-dispatch figure here is a MARGINAL derived by differencing two graphs, not a per-dispatch measurement. Metal timestamp counter sampling is probed as supported and deliberately not encoded (crates/hawking-core/src/metal/mod.rs:704), so the S031 §3 atlas still has no per-dispatch duration column -- what it now has is a per-LEVER one.
The atlas's BYTES and FLOPS columns remain open. The byte arithmetic here covers two levers and is derived from shapes, not instrumented.
The lake fill and mlx_boot were not quiesced by force at any point; the admitted window was waited for, not created.
next: the capability suite on the 628 graph -- unfused and fused on the SAME binary -- and if the floor holds, the pair lever's mechanism, because 84% of the largest win in this graph is not dispatch, not host and not DRAM bandwidth, and nothing here names what it is

AND_THE_KNOWLEDGE_BASE_HAD_A_HOLE_ON_THE.found_by: mutating this receipt's own new AKB law rather than by reading akb.py
AND_THE_KNOWLEDGE_BASE_HAD_A_HOLE_ON_THE.what_the_module_promises: akb.py docstring: 'An axis that does not apply is NONE here and must be backed by the source receipt actually recording that identity ABSENT. A missing field never reads as a covered one.'
AND_THE_KNOWLEDGE_BASE_HAD_A_HOLE_ON_THE.what_it_did: the grounding check reads the source receipt's `identities` block and, when there is none, executed `continue  # receipt predates the identity schema; recorded, not assumed` -- and nothing was recorded. The comment described a behaviour the code did not have.
AND_THE_KNOWLEDGE_BASE_HAD_A_HOLE_ON_THE.why_that_axis_matters_most: NONE on MACHINE is the widest over-claim the schema permits: it turns a measurement on one M3 Ultra into a universal. Four mutations were tried on the new law -- MACHINE, RUNTIME, MODEL and KERNEL all set to NONE -- and ALL FOUR SURVIVED while the receipt had no identities block. The other three mutations tried in the same pass (a bare present-tense comparative, an UNSCOPED axis with no basis, a citation to a receipt that does not exist) were all correctly refused, so the validator was live and this one check was not.
fixed_two_ways: this receipt now carries the full eight-identity block (tools/accelerator/receipt.py IDENTITIES), with transport ABSENT and a reason, so the check actually runs on it -- after which all four NONE over-claims are REFUSED and the honest TOPOLOGY=NONE still validates

akb.build now reports none_claims_not_grounded per entry and a count, so a NONE nobody could check is DISTINGUISHABLE from a NONE that was checked. NOT raised: refusing would retroactively invalidate every law citing a pre-schema receipt, and that is a different decision from making the gap visible.
AND_THE_KNOWLEDGE_BASE_HAD_A_HOLE_ON_THE.and_zero_is_only_a_result_because_the_co: test_a_NONE_that_could_not_be_checked_is_REPORTED_not_silently_skipped strips the identities block off this receipt, rebuilds, requires the count to rise to >=1, and restores. Without that the field would report 0 forever and read as coverage.
AND_THE_KNOWLEDGE_BASE_HAD_A_HOLE_ON_THE.the_other_direction_is_pinned_too: test_a_NONE_contradicted_by_a_PRESENT_identity_is_REFUSED walks MACHINE, RUNTIME, MODEL and KERNEL and requires each to be refused, because reporting the unverifiable ones is worthless if a verifiable over-claim still passes.

extraction.why_a_law_and_not_PROSE_ONLY: ACCELERATOR_QUIESCENCE_INSTRUMENT.json was classified PROSE_ONLY because it describes an instrument with no applicability domain to name. This receipt has one: a body, a codec pair, a kernel set, a machine, a runtime and a workload phase, all measured. It is typed with all eleven axes and its status is negative_result=true.
extraction.still_open_from_the_previous_block: TOKEN_EXECUTION_ATLAS_COUNTS, TOKEN_GRAPH_REDUCTION_TIMED, CAPABILITY_FUSED_GRAPH_CLEARED and FUSION_GAIN_IS_LENGTH_INDEPENDENT are still outside the ACCELERATOR_* glob and still unextracted. This receipt is inside it BY NAME, which is the same fragile membership rule -- it was named ACCELERATOR_* deliberately, and that is a workaround for the scope defect, not a fix for it.
